problem_statement:
Bug #29849046: ASSERT AT SQL_PARSE.CC:6421 IF NON-PRIVILEGED USER TRIES
ENABLING OFFLINE_MODE
RB#22565

The assert was checking if the thread setting the variable has the
privileges needed to "stay alive" after it's being set.

And that is not the case since setting requires SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN
and "staying alive" requires CONNECTION_ADMIN.

Fixed the assert to check the same privileges the (absent) check
function checks.
Test case added.

No changes in the non-debug binaries.
